inputs.name: targets
inputs.description: URLs to scan, each with a report of its own. Required, with no default: list only sites you're allowed to scan.

inputs.name: active_scan
inputs.description: Attack every target with zap-full-scan.py instead of the passive zap-baseline.py. It sends real attacks that can change data or take a site down. Only for sites you own or have written permission to attack.

inputs.name: zap_version
inputs.description: Tag of the ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy image. Change image_digest with it.

inputs.name: image_digest
inputs.description: Digest of ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy for zap_version. ZAP rebuilds the same tag often, so the digest is what fixes what runs.

inputs.name: update_addons
inputs.description: Let ZAP fetch its newest add-ons and beta rules as each scan starts. It finds more, but runs code the image digest doesn't pin.

inputs.name: spider_minutes
inputs.description: Longest the spider walks each target, in minutes.

inputs.name: max_scan_minutes
inputs.description: Longest one target's scan may take, in minutes. A scan that runs out of time counts as failed. Raise it for active scans of large sites.

inputs.name: schedule
inputs.description: When the scan timer runs, as a systemd OnCalendar expression such as "weekly" or "Sun 03:00".

inputs.name: keep
inputs.description: Number of scans to keep under /var/lib/conn3x-zap. Older ones are deleted after each scan.

inputs.name: run_now
inputs.description: Scan during the apply: on the first apply, and again whenever the scan's settings change.
